g.text: One gateway, four services -- each split out for a DIFFERENT consistency/scaling profile
ACID -- the ONE service needing full transaction rigor
eventually consistent, ML-driven, OK to be wrong briefly
Splitting these apart is what keeps one component's load or one component's bug from becoming every component's outage:
a flash-sale spike in catalog reads can't eat capacity the order service needs; a bad recommendation-model deploy can never threaten checkout.
